xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Entered into a settlement agreement on October 09, 2025, to settle certain claims and counterclaims against each other arising out of the arbitration initiated by OEG. SWSS certain counterclaims against OEG were withdrawn in the arbitration. These counterclaims are expressly reserved and will be pursued upon crystallization of the claims.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: OEG, Inc. and Sterling and Wilson Solar Solutions, Inc. have mutually agreed to dismiss the arbitration proceedings between them. The arbitration has been dismissed with prejudice. Certain counterclaims, as referred to in the arbitration order dated March 13, 2025, remain expressly reserved. No costs, expenses, or legal fees have been awarded to either party. The arbitration proceedings stand close pursuant to a general order of dismissal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Arbitral Tribunal passed an interim award whereby the claims of USD 55.06 million (equivalent to approx. INR 485.64 Crore) made by Sterling and Wilson Solar Solutions Inc., (wholly owned step-down subsidiary of the Company) were dismissed and Conti, LLC, USA was granted a claim amount of USD 6.44 million (equivalent to approx. INR 56.80 Crore) plus interest
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Arbitral Tribunal has passed its Final Award and granted an additional amount towards attorney’s fees, costs, and expenses of USD 4.97 million (equivalent to approximately INR 44.45 crore) to Conti LLC in addition to the amount granted under Interim Award plus interest.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Mediation preceded by Summary Suit for recovery of receivables
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Bombay High Court has passed the following order in the Commercial Summary Suit instituted by the Company (the Plaintiff) against Axis Bank Ltd (the Defendant): 1. Leave to defend the Summary Suit is granted to the Defendant subject to their depositing a sum of Rs.61,40,32,471 (Rupees Sixty One Crores Forty Lakhs Thirty-Two Thousand Four Hundred and Seventy One Only) within a period of six weeks from the date of the Order. 2. If the aforesaid deposit is made within the stipulated period, the suit shall be transferred to the list of Commercial Causes and the Defendant shall file written statement within a period of four weeks from the date of deposit. 3. If this conditional order of deposit is not complied with within the aforesaid period, the Plaintiff shall be entitled to apply for an exparte decree against the Defendant after obtaining a Non-deposit Certificate from the Prothonotary and Senior Master of this Court.
